caveats: About 4% of orders are fulfilled on a different calendar day than their appointment date. This file buckets by when work actually happened (fulfilled_at), so it will not reconcile to the Order matrix tab, which uses appointment_date. That is by design.

fulfilled_at is written at completion, not at arrival. For a 15-minute pickup checklist the offset is small; for a 120-minute delivery the timestamp reads roughly two hours late. Treat the Delivery layer as completion time.

On-flex visits (type O) are bucketed by booked slot (scheduled_at), not arrival. Where both timestamps exist, members check in an average of 31 minutes early, so real on-flex demand lands earlier than shown, frequently in the preceding hour. Buckets are not shifted; state the offset in the UI.
The 'all' rollup is P+S+D+R only (fulfilled time basis); on-flex is excluded and stands alone as type O.
Hours are clamped to 8-19 local time; early/late events land in the edge buckets so totals stay whole.
